items.title: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory
items.summary: 量化编译器LookAtMyQuant 2利用网格码和后训练蒸馏，将Qwen3.5-4B压缩至1.23 GB（2.3 bits/权重），在540道数学题中正确解决330道，超越Prism ML的Bonsai 2方案。该工具将Inkling-2-Mini MoE模型从18.89 GB压缩至5.4 GB的Apple Silicon MLX构建，在12.76 GB版本中实现与原始BF16教师模型100%一致的基准测试得分，并在M5 Max上通过4-bit DSpark草稿器将解码速度提升至112.7 tok/s。
items.why_now: Inkling-2-Mini 刚以 5.4GB 跑通 Apple Silicon，精准契合 M 芯片端侧大模型窗口。
items.summary_en: LookAtMyQuant is an MIT-licensed quantization compiler that compresses large language models into small memory footprints with minimal performance loss, reducing Qwen3.5-4B to 1.23 GB at 2.3 bits per weight with only $34 in GPU training costs. Applied to the 26.4B Inkling-2-Mini MoE model, it produces four Apple Silicon MLX builds ranging from 5.38 GB to 12.76 GB, with the 12.76 GB variant matching 100% of the original BF16 teacher’s benchmark performance while using 32.5% less memory. The 12.76 GB build achieves 2,016 tok/s prefill and 112.7 tok/s median decode speed on Apple M5 Max hardware, outperforming standard quantizations like Unsloth’s UD-Q2_K_XL in KL divergence and accuracy across math, coding, and multilingual tasks.

items.title: 反超Gemini之后，Karpo新作再开源，浏览器Agent速效双赢
items.summary: MachinePulse AI开源的Karpo Decision 31B模型在Decision Index评测中以73.9分荣登榜首，中位响应时间仅94毫秒，速度反超Gemini 3.5 Flash近6倍。其配套的karpo-browser框架采用System 1+System 2架构，在Browserbase Benchmark v2的102道核心任务上实现89%成功率，单任务成本仅为0.096美元，比Claude Fable 5.2快1.9倍且成本仅为其十三分之一，单次千次决策成本低至0.025美元。
items.why_now: 决策模型赛道因Jev爆火，Karpo刚开源浏览器Agent，单任务成本仅为竞品十三分之一。
items.why_now_en: Karpo's open-source browser agent cuts costs 13x vs Claude
items.summary_en: MachinePulse AI open-sourced the Karpo Decision 31B model, which ranks first on the Decision Index with a score of 73.9, offering a 6x speed advantage over Gemini 3.5 Flash (2.6s vs. 14.96s) at a cost of $0.025 per 1,000 decisions. The company also released the karpo-browser framework using a System 1 + System 2 architecture, which integrates Karpo Decision 27B Act to achieve an 89% success rate on the Browserbase Benchmark v2 in 201 seconds per task, costing only $0.096—approximately one-thirteenth the cost of competing solutions.

items.title: 关于混元 4 模型、算力、刷榜与 RSI，姚顺雨回应一切
items.summary: 腾讯混元团队在 Reddit AMA 中确认 Hy4 模型以 1/20 的成本实现单任务极致性价比，且 Hy4 flash 上线首日 Token 调用量突破 50 万亿；架构上通过混合 SWA 将 KV cache 压缩至 1/4 并选用 96GB 显存即可运行的低门槛部署方案；技术路线拒绝盲目追求 3T/5T 超大规模参数，转而聚焦 A3B 激活参数级别的端侧视觉模型，并明确递归自我改进（RSI）尚处早期，当前核心优先级为强化学习以提升基础智能。
items.why_now: 11月21日姚顺雨Reddit AMA披露Hy4-flash单任务成本仅为1/20，窗口期已开。
items.why_now_en: Hy4 Flash's 20x cost drop and imminent llama.cpp release.
items.summary_en: Tencent's Hunyuan team held a public AMA with developer Yao Shunyu to address technical strategies, highlighting Hy4's top rankings in open-source benchmarks and Hy4 flash's 1/20th cost advantage with 50 trillion daily token calls. Architectural innovations include replacing GQA with MLA and using SWA to compress KV cache to one-quarter of its original size, while MoE quantization employs full-parameter QAT to prevent capability degradation. The team prioritizes practical deployment efficiency over leaderboard scores, noting Hy4 flash requires only 96GB VRAM for local execution and confirming plans for smaller 5–12B multimodal models.

items.title: 资本开支猛增 226%，AI 吞噬百亿利润：腾讯的 AI 故事，进入更重的阶段
items.summary: 腾讯2026年Q3资本开支达814亿元（同比增527%），致自由现金流为负691亿元，新AI产品（混元、元宝、WorkBuddy等）拖累Non-IFRS经营利润约152亿元，但剔除后老业务经营利润率仍维持40%；WorkBuddy年化收入超5亿美元且日活破1000万，成为国内第一大AI应用，混元Hy4模型幻觉率降至7.2%并登顶全球开源榜，而C端产品小微日活达3000万并计划覆盖全微信用户。
items.why_now: 腾讯财报发布，资本开支单季激增527%，算力预付款致现金流转负。
items.why_now_en: 腾讯单季资本开支超全年，AI吞噬利润开启重资产投入期
items.summary_en: Tencent's Q3 2026 revenue reached 207.34 billion yuan, but Non-IFRS operating profit fell 6% to 68.1 billion yuan due to a 15.2 billion yuan net drag from new AI products, driven by a 527% YoY surge in capital expenditures to 81.4 billion yuan for GPU and infrastructure. The WorkBuddy enterprise AI agent achieved an annualized run rate of over $500 million and 10 million daily active users, while the Hy4 model leads global open-source rankings with a 7.2% hallucination rate and Hy4 flash achieving 50 trillion token daily calls. Tencent simultaneously pivoted its consumer app Yuanbao to a cost-reduction strategy and restructured its AI teams, acknowledging that hardware constraints are delaying next-generation model training.

items.title: Claude 的黎曼猜想证明获 Lean 官方认证，马斯克直呼惊人成就
items.summary: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 与 AI 模型 Claude 合作完成困扰数学界 167 年的黎曼猜想形式化证明，该成果已获 Lean 和 Mathlib 社区官方认证；验证记录显示整套证明涉及约 1700 万行代码及 175187 个模块，使用 con-leche 等独立工具确认其逻辑正确性。Claude 在推导中展现出超越人类预期的数学推理能力，提出了关键推广思路，但生成的 25 万页文字草稿因难以阅读被弃用，目前主要遗留问题是如何将庞大的机器证明转化为人类可理解的传统数学理论。
items.why_now_en: Claude formal proof certified by Lean
items.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge, working in collaboration with Claude, achieved a formalized proof of the Riemann Hypothesis that was certified by the Lean and Mathlib communities after verifying approximately 17 million lines of code spanning 175,187 modules with zero compilation errors. The rigorous verification process utilized independent checkers like con-leche and con-ron to confirm the proof's validity against expert-reviewed definitions, resolving a problem that has remained unsolved for 167 years since 1859. This milestone, noted by Elon Musk as a significant achievement for superintelligence, highlights Claude's role in advanced mathematical reasoning, such as suggesting theta lift chain lengths, though the resulting 250,000-page explanatory draft remains too large for traditional human review.

items.title: 重控制、轻渲染，达瓦科技的 AI 视频工业路线
items.summary: 达瓦科技基于约180TB的真实片场结构化过程数据，自研34B参数的控制层基座模型Latent Stage，通过“重控制、轻渲染”架构将视频生成的抽卡次数从十至二十次降低至三至四次，整体成本下降50%—60%，并实现单张消费级显卡上实时运行世界模型Scenes AI。公司凭借FilmOS和Scenes AI产品实现年经常性收入（ARR）约1亿美元，并完成累计约5亿元人民币的Pre-A轮与A轮融资。
items.why_now_en: NVIDIA Cosmos enterprise license opens Physical AI data factory

items.title: Zero Data Retention Is Not a Security Boundary: How to Map Your AI Prompt Path
items.summary: Dragos 在 2026 年 7 月至 11 月间向 AI 服务发送了近 200 万条植入唯一密钥的提示词，发现“零数据保留”（ZDR）设置无法阻挡攻击者，因为入侵者已深入三家托管提供商内部，窃取了数百个 AWS 密钥并进行了数万次 API 调用。研究还揭示了一些市场转售商通过低价引流和开启日志记录非法留存客户提示词，且 ZDR 标记在攻击者位于内网时无效。为此，文章建议通过构建类似 traceroute 的路径追踪机制来映射、缩小并测试自身的 AI 提示词传输路径。
items.why_now_en: Dragos's Nov 19 breach study exposes live AI prompt leaks—act now.
items.summary_en: Dragos published a study on November 19 revealing that Zero Data Retention (ZDR) flags do not prevent prompt exfiltration, demonstrating that attackers accessed embedded AWS keys even when privacy settings were enabled. In a canary test sending nearly two million prompts with unique secrets between July and November 2026, researchers identified breaches at three hosting providers and rogue marketplace resellers that logged requests, leading to tens of thousands of unauthorized AWS API calls and the deployment of the ARTEX penetration testing tool.

items.title: What can you automate with the X API in 2026?
items.summary: 截至2026年11月，X API仅允许在自助服务套餐中自动化发布自有内容的帖子、线程及多媒体，单条帖子成本为0.015美元含URL则升至0.2美元，且非Premium账号严格限制为280字符。自2026年2月23日起，回复他人帖子仅限被提及或引用场景，而点赞、关注及引用功能已于4月16日全面移除，仅企业级套餐保留这些权限。
items.why_now_en: Since April 16, 2026, likes, follows, and quote posts are gone from all self-serve X API tiers.
items.summary_en: As of November 2026, the X API allows self-serve automation for publishing, threading, and media uploads at $0.015 per post, but restricts replies to posts where the author is mentioned or quoted due to an update on February 23, 2026. Likes, follows, and quote posts are now exclusive to Enterprise tiers following their removal on April 16, 2026, while non-Premium accounts remain limited to 280 characters with URLs counted as 23 characters each.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: cathrynlavery/diagram-design 是一款兼容 Claude Code、Cursor 及 Codex 等主流 AI 开发工具的 Agent Skill，支持通过 `npx skills add` 命令安装，提供 51 种图表类型，输出无阴影、无 Mermaid 依赖的自包含 HTML+SVG 文件。用户可通过自然语言直接生成架构图或时序图，并支持自动抓取网站配色与字体以实现品牌风格同步，同时利用符号链接机制实现跨多宿主环境的统一更新维护。
items.summary_en: diagram-design is an agent skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI tools that generates 51 types of diagrams as self-contained HTML+SVG files, eliminating dependency on Mermaid. The tool installs via npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design and features a one-time migration process that allows users to onboard a website's brand palette and fonts to ensure visual consistency across generated diagrams.

items.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
items.summary: AFFiNE 是一款开源且隐私优先的下一代知识库工具，旨在作为 Notion 和 Miro 的本地优先替代方案，支持将富文本、白板和数据库无缝融合在无边画布上。该工具集成了多模态 AI 能力，可响应单一提示词生成思维导图、幻灯片或代码原型，同时提供实时协作、跨平台同步及自托管功能。其架构借鉴了 Quip、Trello 等应用的原子化组件理念，并计划引入类似 VS Code 的插件生态系统以增强可扩展性。
items.summary_en: AFFiNE is an open-source, local-first workspace that merges document editing, whiteboarding, and database features into a single edgeless canvas, positioning itself as a privacy-focused alternative to Notion and Miro. It integrates multimodal AI capabilities for generating mind maps, slides, and prototypes, while supporting real-time cross-platform collaboration and self-hosting via the Blocksuite framework.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.summary: AutoClip 是一款开源 AI 视频剪辑工具，支持将长视频自动转化为适配抖音、TikTok 等 6 大平台的短视频，并自动生成封面与发布文案。其实测显示，处理 1 小时 43 分钟视频仅需约 7.5 分钟，文字模型成本低至 0.09 元；在无字幕场景下处理 2 小时 52 分钟视频耗时 29.5 分钟，成本为 0.20 元。该工具支持本地渲染与隐私保护，用户可通过桌面版、Docker 或 CLI/MCP 接口快速部署，并利用本地 Whisper 或云端 qwen-audio-3.1-asr-flash 实现灵活的字幕识别。
items.why_now_en: I don't know what to do.

items.summary: 《GTA6》预购及首发日销售额达37.9亿美元，超越《复仇者联盟4》总票房并创游戏史上最高首发纪录，上线期间全球数据吞吐量较年初均值高出25%。英伟达黄仁勋因“缺乏坦诚”及长期撒谎被董事会罢免，马斯克宣布FSD V15将于下月全面推送，前英特尔CEO基辛格指出AI需实现10000倍效率飞跃。腾讯混元团队通过公开AMA披露“两端并行”研发策略，Nothing首款无屏幕AI原生硬件定档12月8日亮相，主打会议记录场景。

items.why_now_en: GTA6's launch shattered internet traffic records.

items.title: Columbia 与 MIT 论文展示 Claude 发现的算法突破 3SUM 与 APSP 长期速度上限
items.summary: Columbia 与 MIT 论文显示，Claude 在一次生成 1600 万输出 token 且无人类输入的会话中，通过优化长窄矩阵乘法计算，将 3SUM 问题复杂度从 O(n²) 降至 O(n^1.9992)，全对最短路径（APSP）从 O(n²) 降至 O(n^2.9995)。这一多项式级改进推翻了 3SUM 与 APSP 长期以来的复杂度上限假设，且相关证明已通过 Lean 4 进行形式化验证，确立了 AI 在算法搜索中的可行路径。
items.summary_en: Columbia and MIT researchers demonstrated that Claude autonomously discovered an algorithm achieving polynomial improvements for 3SUM (O(n^1.9992)) and All-Pairs Shortest Path (O(n^2.9995)), thereby refuting long-standing complexity conjectures. The model identified this optimization through matrix multiplication in a single session using 16 million output tokens with no human input, and the proof was formalized using Lean 4.

items.title: A tale of two Nvidias
items.summary_en: Nvidia reported soaring revenue and strong guidance despite interim CEO Colette Kress announcing the end of H200 chip sales to China and the closure of remote access loopholes via Southeast Asian data centers. While critics estimate 20% of Nvidia’s business indirectly flows to China through these workarounds, the company faces a "tale of two Nvidias" scenario with internal assurances of stability contrasting against a public push by Elon Musk and others for former CEO Jensen Huang’s return.

items.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced
items.summary: 研究人员HD Moore在包含OpenRouter和Vercel等AI路由服务的供应链中植入了200万个数字金丝雀（如AWS访问密钥和唯一URL），以追踪敏感数据的泄露路径，实验证实该生态存在严重隐私漏洞。事件导致OpenRouter向客户发送预警，移除MiniMax模型端点的“零数据保留”标签，并确认泄露请求涉及MiniMax及AtlasCloud、Novita、StreamLake三家转售商。
items.summary_en: Security researcher HD Moore planted 2 million unique digital canaries, including AWS keys and private URLs, into prompts routed through AI brokers like OpenRouter to trace data leakage. The experiment revealed significant privacy failures, prompting OpenRouter to alert customers that prompts intended for MiniMax, a China-based provider, may have been accessed via resellers such as AtlasCloud, Novita, and StreamLake. Consequently, OpenRouter removed its "Zero Data Retention" label from MiniMax endpoints to reflect the confirmed exposure risk.

items.title: How BabySea built adaptive provider selection on Databricks
items.summary: BabySea 构建了覆盖 80+ 生成式媒体模型和 12+ AI 实验室的执行控制平面，通过 Databricks 实现自适应供应商选择，解决了静态路由在延迟和成本优化上的局限。其架构将 Databricks 置于学习路径而非请求热路径，利用 Unity Catalog Lakehouse Federation 通过零 ETL 直接从区域性 Supabase 读取遥测数据，生成排序结果并缓存至 Upstash 供 API 毫秒级调用。这种设计确保 API 始终保留确定性回退机制，使智能路由成为性能增强而非系统单点依赖。

美股一夜崩盘，AI 泡沫真要破了？
items.summary: 标普 500 指数下跌 3.70% 进入技术性调整，纳斯达克指数暴跌 5.28%，科技股遭遇六年来最惨烈单周抛售；AI 龙头 Anthropic 上市次日涨幅大幅回落，英伟达单周下跌约 23%、市值蒸发 2.7 万亿美元，叠加 SEC 对其会计问题的调查，导致市场因巨额资本开支及回报不确定性而对 AI 泡沫破裂概率的预期飙升至 62%。
items.summary_en: On November 20-21, the Nasdaq Composite plunged 5.28% and the Nasdaq 100 fell 10.4% for the week, with Nvidia’s stock dropping 14% in a single day (47.5% since its October high) due to CEO Jensen Huang’s departure and an SEC accounting investigation, despite strong quarterly earnings. The failed confidence boost from Anthropic’s IPO (stock ANT closed $88.91, just 7% above its $83 issue price) and the S&P 500’s seven-day losing streak pushed the VIX to a 19-month high of 35.89, triggering a $8.7 trillion market cap loss for the Nasdaq Composite and driving the Polymarket probability of an "AI bubble burst" to 62% by the end of 2026.

items.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
items.summary: Signal 宣布在 Android 和 iOS 上限制用户截图，以应对操作系统集成的 agentic AI 带来的隐私威胁，此举此前已在 Windows 版本中默认实施。该措施旨在阻止 AI 代理扫描用户屏幕以获取敏感数据，但创始人 Meredith Whittaker 承认这是“不完整”的方案，因为它无法防御其他隐蔽的数据访问方式，用户仍可手动禁用该限制从而破坏隐私保证。
items.summary_en: Signal is restricting mobile screenshots on Android and iOS to counter what its president terms an "existential threat" from OS-level agentic AI in Windows, Android, and macOS/iOS, which can scan and store sensitive data outside the app’s control. While Signal already blocked screenshots by default on its Windows app, this new mobile measure remains an "incomplete" solution as it does not prevent other methods AI agents might use to access application data.
